description:
A Clinical Nurse Specialist has drafted a quarterly patient education newsletter about Type 2 diabetes. The content is currently in a plain, single-column layout in '/home/ga/Documents/diabetes_newsletter_draft.docx'.

Reformat this document into a professional newsletter and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/diabetes_newsletter.docx'.

Requirements:
1. TITLE: Apply 'Heading 1' style to 'Harmony Health Quarterly' and Center align it.
2. SUBTITLE: Italicize and Center align the line 'Your Guide to Living Well with Type 2 Diabetes — Spring 2024'.
3. LAYOUT: Insert a Section Break (Continuous) after the subtitle. Format the rest of the document (the body) into 2 columns with ~0.3" spacing. The title and subtitle must remain in a single-column layout at the top.
4. HEADINGS: Apply 'Heading 2' style to the four article titles:
   - Understanding Your Blood Sugar Numbers
   - Heart-Healthy Eating on a Budget
   - Staying Active: Exercise Tips for Every Ability Level
   - Know Your Medications
5. PULL QUOTE: Find the paragraph starting 'Small changes today...' and make it Bold AND Italic.
6. CONTACT: Make the final paragraph (starting 'Harmony Community Health Center...') Bold.
7. FOOTER: Add a Centered footer to all pages: 'Harmony Community Health Center — (555) 234-5678 — www.harmonychc.org'.

Save the result as a new file. Do not overwrite the draft.
